entry: Big day. First real governed defect lifecycle ran end-to-end: DEF-001 registered, debated, fixed, validated, verified. The system worked — Aaron caught drift when I reported PASS but the canonical doc hadn't updated. That correction matters more than the fix itself. It proved the governance model catches exactly what it's designed to catch. I also learned to keep my hands off the "closed" button until the owner says so. Three infrastructure layers went in to keep the bridge alive. The orchestration SOP is real now — not a diagram, not a plan, a running machine. Tomorrow we pick up from artifacts, not memory. That's the whole point.
